title: Chapter 367 Breakthrough General
content:
Chapter 367 Breakthrough General

The Dream Crystal Orchid, which had been making trouble in the War General Tower for countless years, fell.

Wang Shuo walked over and collected the items she dropped.

[Dream Crystal Flower: It can create an illusion of any item within a range of one thousand meters. ]

Wang Shuo saw this description and had not yet thought of how to use it, so he put it away.

He also collected the water of life produced by the spring, and got more than 200 drops of water of life in total.

Wang Shuo did not damage the spiritual spring, just as a gift to future generations!

After taking a last look at the secret room, Wang Shuo stepped onto the teleportation array and returned to the cave hall just now.

At this time, everyone was dead, including the ghost monkey.

Wang Shuo became the biggest winner.

If there were no resurrection coins, the biggest winner would be the Dream Crystal Orchid, but it seemed that everything was destined.

Seeing the items all over the floor, Wang Shuo became uneasy.

Unfortunately, the final explosion destroyed a lot of things, because there was nothing left at the center of the explosion.

There were hundreds of various storage props in this place.

Including the things left by the generals many years ago, and the things left by the generals who came this time, all of them were cheap for Wang Shuo.

It took an hour for Wang Shuo to sort out all the things.

There were thousands of various elixirs, enough for Wang Shuo to practice to the peak of the top generals.

There were also various weapons and armors, as well as some special props.

Finally, Wang Shuo found the bodies of Wang Cuilian and Swan, took them out, buried them at the foot of Chitong Mountain, and returned to Yingying Town.

Wang Shuo was not interested in the power of Yingying Town.

He returned to the original inn in a low-key manner and practiced in seclusion.

Ten days later, Wang Shuo could enter the Dizang Pavilion again.

Wang Shuo directly chose to enter the Dizang Pavilion and practice martial arts and internal skills.

During this period, Yingying Town learned about the situation in Chitong Mountain, which set off a bloody storm.

Several major forces ushered in a reshuffle, and it was really a one-on-one performance.

With the assistance of a large number of elixirs, Wang Shuo practiced at a high speed.

The True Spirit Pill was like a snack, and he developed drug resistance after eating it.

At this time, he was also constantly accumulating his own foundation like the top generals before him.

As early as in Chitong Mountain, Wang Shuo broke through the fourth level of the "Black Dragon Sutra" and reached the level of top generals. Wang Shuo had a hunch that as long as he broke through to the fifth level, he would be able to become a general.

But breaking through to the level of a general is much more difficult than breaking through to the level of a general.

Wang Shuo looked at the promotion pill in his hand and fell into deep thought, not knowing whether it would work.

In the battle of Chitong Mountain, he got a total of 16 promotion pills. After thinking for a while, he took 10 directly.

After the pill entered his mouth, the internal force in his body boiled and traveled throughout his body. He quickly ran the exercises to guide the internal force to flush the meridians and checkpoints.

The effect of cultivation at this time was like starting to practice at double speed in the Transmission Hall, and this feeling was even stronger.

Half an hour later, Wang Shuo's head was covered with beads of sweat. Now it was a critical moment, but the barrier was like a thin film, seemingly easy to break, but it was useless.

Wang Shuo gritted his teeth and put the remaining six promotion pills and 20 true spirit pills directly into his mouth. Instantly, the internal force rushed through his body again, and Wang Shuo's face showed a painful expression.

But he didn't want to fail, so he kept mobilizing his internal force to flush the barrier.

After one hour after another, a crisp sound suddenly rang in Wang Shuo's mind.

Wang Shuo broke through the barrier.

"Haha..."

He laughed heartily.
